$GRAB is ready to grow 30-50% revenue for 2026!

Grab Holdings Limited ($GRAB) has strategically partnered with national tourism authorities in its 8 operating countries—Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam to accelerate tourism recovery and growth. These collaborations focus on leveraging Grab's superapp for seamless mobility, deliveries, and payments, targeting a projected 120-130 million international visitors to Southeast Asia in 2024-2025.

Below is the Thai Tourism Ad released in May 2025 with Tourism Authority of Thailand as one of the example!

1. Key enablers include the OpenAI partnership (May 2024), which deploys AI for personalized recommendations, smarter mapping (e.g., GPT-4o vision fine-tuning for traffic signs and lanes), and enhanced user experiences like voice-assisted navigation for tourists

2. The Alipay+ partnership (initial 2023, deepened September 2025), which integrates Grab rides/deliveries directly into Alipay, AlipayHK, and GCash via Alipay+ Voyager, enabling 1 billion+ Chinese users to book services without app downloads, boosting cross-border tourism by 30-40% in high-traffic destinations.

Timeline of this strategic boost to grow revenue much faster:

-04/17/23: Regional: ASEAN Tourism Forum & Multi-Country Tie-Ups (All 8 Countries). Grab launches in-app travel features (e.g., language localization in 8 languages, tourist SIM partnerships) to support post-COVID recovery. Ties into ASEAN-wide tourism data from the 2023 ASEAN Tourism Forum, projecting 120-130M visitors by 2024. Boosts hyperlocal experiences like airport transfers in tourist hubs 

-October 2023: Grab sponsors TAT's "Amazing Thailand" campaigns, providing rides/deliveries for events like Loy Krathong. Supports 25M+ international arrivals in 2023, focusing on secondary cities.

-Early 2024: Grab shares mapping data with VNAT for traffic management in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, aiding 12.6M visitors (70% pre-pandemic recovery). Includes partnerships for sustainable tourism in Halong Bay routes

-March 2024: Grab provides anonymized data to MOTAC for optimizing tourist routes in Kuala Lumpur and Penang, supporting "Visit Malaysia 2026" campaign targeting 28M visitors.

-May 2024: Grab deploys ChatGPT Enterprise and GPT-4o across operations, piloting AI for GrabMaps (vision fine-tuning on 65M+ POIs) and agentic tools (e.g., AI Merchant Assistant for personalized tourist offers). First OpenAI collab in SEA, enhancing accessibility for 42M monthly users.

-June 2024: Grab partners for Bali and Jakarta tourism events under "Wonderful Indonesia," providing mobility for 16M projected visitors. Includes cloud kitchen expansions for tourist dining.

-August 2024: Grab supports Cambodian tourism via data for Phnom Penh/Siem Reap traffic management, aligning with Angkor Wat promotions for 6M+ visitors. Part of broader SEA recovery.

-September 2024: Grab collaborates on Yangon mobility data sharing for post-recovery tourism with Myanmar: Ministry of Hotels and Tourism (target: 3M visitors by 2025), focusing on safe rides to cultural sites.

-March 2025: Deepened MOU for sponsoring mega-events (e.g., S2O Songkran, Maha Songkran Festival) under "Amazing Thailand Grand Tourism and Sports Year 2025." Targets 40M visitors; expands airport pickups and inter-city rides.

-May 2025: Grab supports Philippines-led ASEAN visa scheme (unifying travel across Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam) via integrated mobility. Simplifies multi-country trips, boosting regional tourism by 20-25%.

-August 2025: Formal MOU to use data insights for curated F&B recommendations and geo-location tools. Builds on H1 2025's 8.33M arrivals and $8.07B spend; promotes hawker centers and neighborhoods. STB-OpenAI MoU (July 2025) extends AI integration for tourism.

-September 5th 2025: Philippines: Department of Tourism (DOT) – Digital Tourism Partnership
MOA as Official Digital Tourism Partner to modernize gastronomy and inter-city connectivity. Focuses on food deliveries/rides to sites like Boracay/Cebu; targets 8.5M visitors under 2025 campaigns.

-September 15 2025: Regional: Alipay+ Voyager Deepening (All 8 Countries). Expanded integration allows direct Grab ride bookings within Alipay/AlipayHK/GCash. Targets 33m+ Chinese tourists; includes stablecoin settlements (e.g., StraitsX XSGD) for instant merchant payouts.

$GRAB FY 2025 guidance is $3.4B, but most likely to hit $3.5B. These tourism and OpenAI partnership will drive Grab SuperApp revene growth to 30-50% in 2026. GRABMart will also drive a major % of revenue growth in H2 2025 and 2026. GrabUnlimited, GrabAds will contribute greatly to bottom line while others contribute a greater % to topline growth. 

My calculation: 2026 tourism expansion could contribute $500m-$1B to Grab overall Revenue. 

With that said, it is important to keep our eyes on average revenue growth instead of 1 good year. I'm maintaining my projection at 30% average revenue growth toward 2035. 

Excluded regional expansion, Excluded B2B products that we are not aware of. 

Meaning, FY2026 could hit over $5.2B revenue.
